description:
Where a run is and what it has found so far. Runs take minutes, so it reports progress rather than a final answer until it has one.

A run can pause and ask: it reports what finishing would buy and cost, and goes no further until you agree. When it ends, `orbbai_read_report` hands back a person’s findings and `orbbai_table_read` the table a search leaves; `orbbai_ways_in_for_a_goal` weighs finished research against a goal.

Free.

runId.description: The run id from `orbbai_run_start`, or from `orbbai_plan` with a `company`, which starts its run while planning.

name: orbbai_run_status
